steps.title: Detach cells with Accutase
steps.instruction: Add Accutase to adherent cells, incubate until cells detach, then pipette repeatedly in medium to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Crosslink cells in suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the single‑cell suspension in 1.5 % formaldehyde prepared in PBS (use 10 mL per 10 × 10⁶ cells). Rotate gently and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench formaldehyde with glycine
steps.instruction: Add 1 M glycine to the crosslinking mixture to a final concentration of 130 mM (add 1.5 mL glycine per 10 mL formaldehyde). Mix gently.

steps.title: Pellet cells and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the quenched cells at 2000 rpm for 2 min, discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in PBS‑T (Tween‑20 0.1 % v/v) using a volume equal to the formaldehyde volume previously added, spin 2000 rpm 2 min, discard supernatant, and repeat once more.

steps.title: Final PBS‑T resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cell pellet in a small volume of PBS‑T (e.g., 1–2 mL) and keep on ice.

steps.title: Plate‑based crosslinking (alternative)
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, remove medium from each 10 cm dish, add 10 mL of 1.5 % formaldehyde (or 20 mL if >10 × 10⁶ cells). Quench with glycine to 130 mM, discard liquid, add 10 mL PBS, rotate, discard, repeat PBS wash once, then add 3 mL PBS‑T (0.1 % Tween‑20) optionally containing Complete protease inhibitor, scrape cells with a cell lifter, collect on one side of the plate and transfer to a 15 mL or 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Lyse cells with LB3 buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare LB3 buffer mixed with 1× Complete protease inhibitor (≈10 mL per 10 cm plate). Add LB3 to the plate, gently rotate, discard liquid, repeat once, then add a final 3 mL of LB3+Complete, scrape cells, and collect the suspension in a Falcon tube.

steps.title: Pellet lysate and freeze
steps.instruction: Spin the collected lysate at 2000 rpm for 2 min, discard supernatant, and either freeze immediately in liquid nitrogen (pause point) or store at –80 °C for months.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration (BCA)
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of lysate, add 1 µL Benzonase, add 30 µL SDS wash buffer, heat 95 °C for 5 min. Prepare standards similarly (5 µL standard + 30 µL SDS buffer, heat 95 °C 5 min). Load 25 µL of each sample/standard onto a 96‑well plate and measure protein concentration using the BCA kit (use a 2 mg/mL standard and a blank).

steps.title: Count cells and aliquot
steps.instruction: Count cells and aliquot e.g., 24 × 10⁶ cells per 15 mL polypropylene tube (avoid polystyrene tubes). Spin 2000 rpm 2 min, discard supernatant, and freeze aliquots in liquid nitrogen (or store at –80 °C).

steps.title: Prepare cells for sonication
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in LB3+Complete at 1 mL per 10⁶ cells (e.g., 1 mL for 1 × 10⁶ cells), vortex, and split into two 1.5 mL Bioruptor Pico tubes. Do not exceed 12 × 10⁶ cells per tube. Optionally add SDS to a final 0.1 % to improve sonication efficiency.

steps.title: Sonicate chromatin
steps.instruction: Sonicate using a Bioruptor Pico with 7 cycles of 30 s ON / 30 s OFF (or equivalent Covaris settings). After sonication, spin tubes 10 min at 12 000 g, collect the supernatant into a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Pre‑IP buffer wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sonicated chromatin in 0.9 mL Tris‑Cl 10 mM, add 100 µL 10 % Triton X‑100 (v/v), incubate on ice 5 min (optional: add Complete protease inhibitor). Spin 2 min at 2000 rpm, discard supernatant.

steps.title: LB3 wash steps
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL LB3 buffer, spin 2 min at 2000 rpm, discard supernatant. Repeat this LB3 wash two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Final resuspension for IP
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in LB3 buffer at 250 µL per 8 × 10⁶ cells (e.g., 750 µL for a confluent 10 cm dish ≈20 × 10⁶ cells).

steps.title: Adjust protein amount
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration (as above) and adjust the lysate with LB3+Complete to obtain ≤1 mg protein per 2‑mL tube. Freeze at –80 °C if not used immediately (pause point).

steps.title: Add antibody for IP
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate amount of antibody (2–10 µg or 1:50–1:100 v/v) to each tube, mix gently, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Post‑IP clarification
steps.instruction: Spin the overnight IP at 12 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C, collect 95 % of the supernatant, and adjust the volume to 1 mL with IP buffer.

steps.title: Prepare magnetic beads
steps.instruction: For each tube, aliquot 40 µL Protein A or Protein G Dynabeads, wash once with IP buffer, and add the washed beads to the IP mixture.

steps.title: Incubate with beads
steps.instruction: Rotate the bead‑antibody‑chromatin complexes 2–4 h at 4 °C (or overnight) on a rotating wheel.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in Cutsmart
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnet, discard liquid, and resuspend beads in 200 µL 1× NEB Cutsmart buffer by gentle swirling (do not pipet).

steps.title: Prepare DNA end‑labeling master mix
steps.instruction: For each tube, mix: 10 µL 10× Cutsmart buffer, 2 µL Klenow 3’‑exo‑, 1 µL dBTP (10 mM, all bases except dATP), 1 µL Biotin‑dATP (1 mM), 10 µL T4 PNK, and water to 100 µL total.

steps.title: End‑label DNA on beads
steps.instruction: Add the 100 µL labeling mix to each bead suspension, swirl gently, and incubate 37 °C for 30 min at 700 rpm in a thermomixer.

steps.title: TdT labeling preparation
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnet, discard liquid, resuspend beads in 100 µL 1× TdT buffer (do not vortex, just swirl).

steps.title: TdT reaction
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL TdT enzyme and optional 1 µL RNase A to each tube, mix gently, and incubate 37 °C for 30 min at 800 rpm.

steps.title: Wash beads with IP buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads 4 times with 1 mL ice‑cold IP buffer at room temperature: invert to resuspend, spin briefly, place on magnet, remove liquid each time.

steps.title: Final IP wash removal
steps.instruction: After the fourth wash, remove the last IP wash buffer and discard.

steps.title: Denature proteins on beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 100 µL SDS 7.5 % + DTT 200 mM, vortex vigorously, and incubate 15 min at 37 °C with 1000 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Collect denatured lysate
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnet, collect the supernatant (contains DNA), and discard the beads.

steps.title: Prepare DNase labeling mix
steps.instruction: For each tube, combine 20 µL TdT buffer (with CoCl₂), 5 µL Biotin‑dCTP, 5 µL Biotin‑ddUTP, and water to 95 µL total.

steps.title: Dilute lysate and add streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Dilute the collected supernatant with 1000 µL IP buffer, add 70 µL Streptavidin magnetic beads, and rotate 30–60 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Capture biotinylated DNA
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnet for 2 min, discard the solution, and retain the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads with SDS buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads 3 times with SDS wash buffer: resuspend by vortexing, spin briefly, magnet for 2 min, remove supernatant each time.

steps.title: Wash with BW2x buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads once with BW2x buffer, following the same vortex‑spin‑magnet procedure.

steps.title: Wash with isopropanol buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads once with isopropanol wash buffer, using vortex‑spin‑magnet steps.

steps.title: Wash with acetonitrile buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with acetonitrile wash buffer, using vortex‑spin‑magnet steps.

steps.title: Transfer beads to PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 80 µL acetonitrile wash buffer, transfer the entire suspension to PCR tubes, ensuring all beads are moved.

steps.title: Final bead wash removal
steps.instruction: Place PCR tubes on magnet, remove wash buffer, spin briefly, and discard any residual liquid.

steps.title: Digest proteins for MS
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 20 µL 50 mM Ammonium bicarbonate (or 50 mM TEAB for dimethylation/TMT) containing 10 mM DTT. Incubate 50 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Reduce and alkylate
steps.instruction: Cool the suspension, add 2 µL 0.4 M IAA, vortex, incubate 15–30 min (dark). Add 0.5 µL 1 M DTT to quench the IAA.

steps.title: Add Lys‑C protease
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL Lys‑C (100 ng/µL, total 300 ng), vortex, spin briefly, and incubate overnight (12–16 h) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Separate beads and reverse crosslinks
steps.instruction: Place tubes on magnet, transfer the supernatant (contains peptides and DNA) to new PCR tubes, keep beads for later DNA cleanup. Heat the supernatant at 95 °C for 5 min to reverse formaldehyde cross‑links.

steps.title: Trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Trypsin (100 ng/µL, total 100 ng) to each tube, incubate 37 °C for 8 h.

steps.title: Acidify digests
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL 10 % TFA to each digest to lower pH.

steps.title: Prepare zip‑tip for desalting
steps.instruction: Condition a C‑18 Zip‑Tip with 20 µL 100 % acetonitrile, discard. Equilibrate twice with 20 µL 0.1 % TFA, discarding each time.

steps.title: Load peptides onto Zip‑Tip
steps.instruction: Aspirate and dispense each sample through the Zip‑Tip ten times (avoid bubbles).

steps.title: Wash Zip‑Tip
steps.instruction: Wash the tip once with 20 µL 0.1 % TFA, discard the wash (to avoid carry‑over).

steps.title: Elute peptides
steps.instruction: Elute peptides by pipetting 20 µL 80 % acetonitrile + 0.1 % formic acid into a glass autosampler insert.

steps.title: Dry and reconstitute peptides
steps.instruction: Dry the eluate in a speed‑vac, then reconstitute in 8 µL 2 % DMSO + 0.1 % formic acid.

steps.title: Inject into mass spectrometer
steps.instruction: Inject 7 µL of the reconstituted peptide solution (out of 8 µL) into the mass spectrometer.

steps.title: DNA cleanup with Ampure XP (optional)
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads (from step 31) in 23 µL SDS wash buffer, add 2 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/µL), incubate 55 °C 15 min then 95 °C 10 min. Place tubes on magnetic rack, remove beads, add 50 µL Ampure XP beads, vortex, wait 10 min, spin, place on magnet, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol (discard each time), spin, place on magnet, resuspend beads in 20 µL 10 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8.0, spin, place on magnet, collect supernatant into new tubes for qPCR or library preparation.

steps.title: Modify streptavidin beads (optional)
steps.instruction: Transfer beads to magnet, wait 5 min, discard liquid. Wash once with 10 mL PBS‑T (0.1 % Tween‑20). Resuspend in 7 mL 0.2 M sodium cyanoborohydride in PBS‑T (prepare 0.125 g NaBH₃CN in 10 mL PBS‑T). Add 7 mL 4 % formaldehyde (mix 2.5 mL 16 % formaldehyde with 7.5 mL PBS‑T). Rotate 2 h at room temperature. Magnet 5 min, discard liquid. Wash sequentially with 10 mL 0.1 M Tris‑Cl pH 7.5, then 10 mL PBS‑T, then 5 mL PBS‑T. Store modified beads in PBS‑T at +4 °C for months.
